content_sections.heading: Chitrakoot UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Chitrakoot UP Anganwadi / Appointing Authority, Chitrakoot has officially released the notification dated 5 August 2026 for the recruitment of 92 Anganwadi Karyakatri and Anganwadi Sahayika vacancies. The notification includes complete details on project-wise and area-wise vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, residential requirements, educational qualifications, reservation and priority provisions, selection process, documents required, and online application instructions. Candidates are advised to read the complete notification carefully before submitting their applications. The notification is available through the official departmental website. content_sections.heading: Chitrakoot UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Notification Release Date: 5 August 2026 Online Application Start Date: As per the departmental website upanganwadibharti.in (specific start date not mentioned in the notification) Last Date to Apply Online: 5 September 2026, till midnight 12:00 AM Age Reckoning (Cut-off) Date: 1 July 2025 The exact dates for document verification, merit list release, or interview (if any) are not mentioned in this notification. Candidates should keep checking the official website for further updates.

content_sections.heading: Chitrakoot UP Anganwadi Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The complete ward-wise, Gram Sabha-wise and Anganwadi centre-wise vacancy and reservation details are available on the notice boards of the District Collectorate, Vikas Bhavan, Tehsil, and Vikas Khand offices, as well as on the official website upanganwadibharti.in. This article does not include category-wise (SC/ST/OBC/UR) reservation figures, as these are not specified in the source notification and are instead published separately on notice boards and the website. The notification also clarifies that the number of vacant posts may increase or decrease, and the selection committee holds the right to recruit or not recruit against these posts, or to cancel the recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: Chitrakoot UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the following eligibility conditions specified in the official notification: Only women candidates are eligible to apply for the advertised posts. The candidate must be a permanent resident of the Ward/Gram Sabha of the vacant post. If an eligible candidate is not available in that Ward/Gram Sabha, then a permanent resident of the concerned Nyaya Panchayat will be considered. In urban areas, while applying online, the candidate's residence certificate must clearly mention the relevant ward number and ward name. For the Anganwadi Sahayika post, the minimum educational qualification is Intermediate (12th pass) or its equivalent , and the maximum qualification considered is Postgraduate . The merit list will be prepared on the basis of the postgraduate qualification where applicable. The notification does not separately specify the educational qualification for the Anganwadi Karyakatri post; candidates are advised to check the detailed information available on the official website upanganwadibharti.in or from the District Programme Officer (Child Development Wing) office.

content_sections.heading: Chitrakoot UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility. Candidates belonging to the BPL (Below Poverty Line) category will be given preference/priority, as per the Uttar Pradesh Government's Social Welfare Department (Section-2) order no. 22/2015/2123/26-2-2015 dated 14 September 2015 (as amended). Only income certificates issued by the competent authority under the UP Government Revenue Department (Section-9) order no. 3959/1-9-11-Raj-9 dated 30 September 2011 (as amended), and verifiable online, will be considered valid. For widow candidates , the death certificate and family register copy issued by the Gram Panchayat Officer or the concerned municipal body will be valid. For divorced and abandoned/deserted women , the relevant legal order issued by a court will be considered valid.

content_sections.heading: Chitrakoot UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Based on the available information in the notification, the selection process for the Anganwadi Sahayika post is merit-based , prepared according to educational qualification (with preference given to higher qualification up to postgraduate level) along with applicable reservation/priority benefits such as the BPL category. Further specific stages of selection (such as interview or document verification schedule) are not detailed in this notification.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Chitrakoot UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: As per the notification, the following documents/certificates are relevant during the application and verification process: Residence certificate (with ward number/name mentioned for urban candidates), issued online with digital signature from the Tehsil Caste certificate, issued online with digital signature from the Tehsil (where applicable) Income certificate issued by the competent authority (for BPL/priority claims) Death certificate and family register copy (for widow candidates) Relevant court order (for divorced/abandoned women candidates) Self-attested scanned copies of educational and other relevant documents to be uploaded on the portal, in clean and legible condition The notification does not provide a complete, separate checklist of documents beyond those mentioned above; candidates should refer to the detailed application form on the official website for the full list.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Chitrakoot UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official departmental website: upanganwadibharti.in Locate and open the online application form for Anganwadi Karyakatri/Sahayika recruitment for Chitrakoot district. Fill in the application form carefully and accurately with all required personal, educational, and residence details. Upload self-attested scanned copies of the required documents in a clean and legible format, as specified on the portal. Review the filled application form thoroughly before final submission, since errors in facts, figures, or academic records may lead to rejection of the application. Submit the application form on or before the last date, 5 September 2026 (till midnight 12:00 AM). Important: Only online applications submitted through the official departmental website will be accepted. Offline applications will not be accepted or considered valid under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Chitrakoot UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online only, through upanganwadibharti.in. Offline or hard-copy applications will not be entertained. Residence and caste certificates will be considered valid only if issued through online digital signature by the Tehsil, and if they can be verified online. If any factual error, incorrect figures, or fabricated academic records are found in the application, the candidature will be cancelled. The number of vacant posts may increase or decrease, and the selection committee has the right to recruit or not recruit against the advertised posts, or to cancel the recruitment. For the Anganwadi centre "Chilli Rakas" under the Pahadi Child Development Project (Centre Code 09136050413), located in Ward-10 (Kalindi Nagar), only resident candidates of that ward will be eligible, and selection will follow urban-area norms. Complete details of vacant posts (Gram Sabha-wise/ward-wise), along with reservation details, are displayed on the notice boards of the District Collectorate, Vikas Bhavan, Tehsil, and Vikas Khand offices, as well as on the official website. For further information, candidates can contact the District Programme Officer (Child Development Wing) office or the respective Child Development Project Office at the Vikas Khand, during office hours.

content_sections.heading: District-wise UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who have completed their Intermediate or postgraduate qualification can also explore more Uttar Pradesh Government Jobs and Anganwadi Recruitment Jobs available across India. Women candidates looking for similar opportunities can also check the latest Women-Only Government Jobs across various departments. Applicants searching for openings closer to their region can explore more Chitrakoot Government Jobs and other ICDS Anganwadi Vacancies matching their qualification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Chitrakoot Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for Chitrakoot Anganwadi Karyakatri/Sahayika Recruitment 2026 is 5 September 2026, till midnight 12:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are there in Chitrakoot Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 92 vacancies, comprising 23 posts of Anganwadi Karyakatri and 69 posts of Anganwadi Sahayika.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for Chitrakoot Anganwadi Karyakatri/Sahayika posts?
faq.answer: Only women candidates who are permanent residents of the relevant Ward/Gram Sabha (or Nyaya Panchayat, if no eligible candidate is available in the Ward/Gram Sabha) can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Chitrakoot Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 35 years, calculated as on the cut-off date of 1 July 2025.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Anganwadi Sahayika post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is Intermediate (12th pass) or its equivalent, and the maximum qualification considered for merit is postgraduate.

faq.question: Q6. Can offline applications be submitted for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No. Only online applications submitted through upanganwadibharti.in will be accepted. Offline applications are not valid under any circumstances.

faq.question: Q7. What documents are required for widow or divorced women candidates?
faq.answer: Widow candidates need a death certificate and family register copy issued by the Gram Panchayat Officer or concerned municipal body. Divorced or abandoned women need the relevant legal order issued by a court.

faq.question: Q8. Where can candidates get more information about this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit upanganwadibharti.in or contact the District Programme Officer (Child Development Wing) office or the respective Child Development Project Office at the Vikas Khand during office hours.
